use_case: AI quality inspection on processing lines: camera-based detection of foreign material, seal defects, and label and lot-code errors on packaged products
business_owner: Division VP Food Safety and Quality Assurance (FSQA)
vendor_or_model: AI vision inspection vendor (vendor-trained computer vision models; edge inference servers on plant control networks; training in the vendor cloud)
data_categories: Product and label images; lot codes from MES; incidental images of workers' hands and arms (no audio)
human_in_the_loop: AI can only divert packs to a QA review bin; QA technicians decide every diverted pack; metal detector CCPs and manual visual inspection unchanged; operators can switch to bypass
applicable_laws: 9 CFR 417.4(a)(3)(i) reassessment if AI-001 changes processing methods or systems or becomes part of CCP monitoring; FMIA misbranding and 9 CFR 418.2 for label or lot-code errors that reach commerce; C-FOOD-AG-R01 (21 CFR 121.157(b)(1)-(2), (c)(1)) for the Plant 6 pilot; FTC Act Section 5 (N42-R01) for vendor claims; POL-05 4.8 (no worker evaluation)
status: In production on 7 lines at Plants 1, 3, and 4; pilot on 2 lines at Plant 6. Approved with conditions: bacon runs in bypass until retrained; Plant 6 plant-based line pilot suspended until the food defense reanalysis

use_case: Predictive maintenance on ammonia refrigeration compressors (failure risk scores and suggested work orders)
vendor_or_model: In-house model on the group data platform (SYS-G3) using read-only historian exports
data_categories: Compressor vibration, temperature, pressure, and run-hour data from SYS-M4 (no personal data)
consequential_decision_category: None (re-tier to Safety/CI if it can ever write to controllers)
human_in_the_loop: Refrigeration managers decide every work order; the model has no write path to SYS-M4; required PSM inspections and tests continue on their own schedule
applicable_laws: 29 CFR 1910.119(j)(4) inspection and testing still required (model supplements, never replaces); 40 CFR Part 68 program unchanged; POL-01 4.13 change control for data exports
status: In production at Plants 1, 3, and 6; approved

use_case: Demand forecasting and replenishment suggestions for DC purchasing and store orders
business_owner: Food Distribution supply chain planning director
vendor_or_model: Forecasting module in the WMS and ERP (vendor model, configured)
data_categories: Sales, orders, promotions, seasonality (no personal data)
human_in_the_loop: Buyers and store managers review and adjust every suggested order
applicable_laws: Contract terms; FTC Act Section 5 (N42-R01) applies only to vendor claims

use_case: Route optimization for the private fleet (stop sequence, delivery windows, reefer pre-cool timing)
data_categories: Delivery addresses and windows; trailer telematics; driver location and hours data
human_in_the_loop: Dispatchers approve every route plan; drivers may report unsafe or infeasible routes; routes cannot override hours-of-service limits from the electronic logging data
applicable_laws: 49 CFR Part 395 (hours of service; the optimizer must respect it); 21 CFR 1.908 (temperature control during transport); state breach laws for driver location data (Florida worked example: a name with geolocation information is personal information under Fla. Stat. 501.171(1)(g)1.a.(VII)); POL-04 Restricted data handling
status: In production; approved with conditions (hours-of-service check before dispatch; driver data retention 13 months)

use_case: Store loss-prevention camera analytics flagging possible non-scans and concealment at self-checkout from CCTV video
vendor_or_model: Camera analytics vendor (vendor models; video processed in the vendor cloud); facial recognition disabled by configuration
data_categories: CCTV video of shoppers and workers at self-checkout; transaction logs
consequential_decision_category: None (group override to High: in-store surveillance can lead to shoppers being stopped or accused)
human_in_the_loop: Alerts go to trained asset protection staff, who must review the video before any approach; staff may only offer checkout help, never detain or accuse on an alert; no alert enters any record about a named person
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5 (N44-45-R02; FTC Rite Aid order, Dec 2023, as the signal for in-store AI surveillance); state consumer privacy and biometric laws in each operating state (generic; facial recognition prohibited by group decision); POL-05 4.8; privacy notice (P03 RT-G66)
status: Pilot at 12 stores; no expansion. Approved to continue the pilot with conditions; privacy review due 2027-01-31

use_case: Personalized loyalty offers (offer selection from purchase history)
data_categories: Loyalty member purchase history, contact data, and offer responses for about 6.5 million members
human_in_the_loop: Marketing reviews offer rules and excluded categories each quarter; members can opt out of personalized offers
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5 (N44-45-R02) for data use matching the privacy notice; state consumer privacy laws in each operating state where thresholds are met (generic)
status: In production; approved; excluded-categories review due 2027-03-31 (P01 RT-018)

use_case: Workforce scheduling optimizer proposing store shifts from demand forecasts and stated availability
data_categories: Employee availability, skills, labor forecasts, time and attendance data
consequential_decision_category: Employment (re-tier to High if used for discipline, attendance points, or hours reductions)
human_in_the_loop: Store managers build and approve every schedule; employees can request changes; the optimizer does not use protected characteristics
applicable_laws: Title VII, the ADA, and the ADEA apply to scheduling practices whatever the tool; state wage and hour laws (generic); POL-05 4.8
status: In production at 120 stores; approved with conditions (no use for discipline; annual hours-distribution review by store)

use_case: Enterprise generative AI assistant for the workforce (drafting and summarizing internal documents)
vendor_or_model: Enterprise AI assistant under contract terms that prohibit training on group data
data_categories: Internal documents; Restricted data not permitted (formulations, food defense plans, cardholder and personal data)
human_in_the_loop: Users review all outputs; prohibited for food safety, food defense, HACCP, or employment decisions
applicable_laws: POL-05 4.7; POL-04 4.9; trade secret protection; 21 CFR 121.325 confidentiality context for the Plant 6 food defense plan; NIST AI 600-1
status: Pilot (1,500 workforce users); approved for the pilot
